WITH plandata AS ( SELECT pp.prod_plan_date, sum(pp.prod_plan_qty) total_plan_qty FROM production_plan pp JOIN item i ON (pp.item_id = i.item_id)
i.item_name = #{searchItem}
GROUP BY pp.prod_plan_date ), workdata AS ( SELECT pp.prod_plan_date, sum(wo.order_qty) total_order_qty FROM production_plan pp JOIN WORK_ORDER wo ON (pp.prod_plan_id = wo.prod_plan_id) JOIN item i ON (pp.item_id = i.item_id)
i.item_name = #{searchItem}
GROUP BY pp.prod_plan_date ), defectdate AS ( SELECT pp.prod_plan_date, sum(dl.defect_qty) total_defect_qty FROM production_plan pp JOIN work_order wo ON (pp.prod_plan_id = wo.prod_plan_id) JOIN production p ON (wo.order_id = p.order_id) JOIN inspection i ON (p.prod_id = i.prod_id) JOIN DEFECT_LIST dl ON (i.insp_id = dl.insp_id) JOIN item it ON (pp.item_id = it.item_id)
it.item_name = #{searchItem}
GROUP BY pp.prod_plan_date ), defect_reason AS ( SELECT pp.prod_plan_date, d.defect_name AS defect_name, SUM(dl.defect_qty) AS reason_qty FROM production_plan pp JOIN work_order wo ON (pp.prod_plan_id = wo.prod_plan_id) JOIN production p ON (wo.order_id = p.order_id) JOIN inspection i ON (p.prod_id = i.prod_id) JOIN DEFECT_LIST dl ON (i.insp_id = dl.insp_id) JOIN defect d ON (dl.defect_id = d.defect_id) JOIN item it ON (pp.item_id = it.item_id)
it.item_name = #{searchItem}
GROUP BY pp.prod_plan_date, d.defect_name )
SELECT to_char(p.prod_plan_date,'YYYY-IW') 계획일자, round(avg(total_plan_qty),1) 생산계획량, round(avg(nvl(w.total_order_qty,0)),1) 작업량, round(avg(nvl(d.total_defect_qty,0)),1) 불량수량, ( SELECT LISTAGG(dr.defect_name || ':' || dr.reason_qty, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY dr.reason_qty DESC) FROM defect_reason dr WHERE TO_CHAR(dr.prod_plan_date, 'YYYY-IW') = TO_CHAR(p.prod_plan_date, 'YYYY-IW') ) AS 불량사유상세 FROM plandata p LEFT OUTER JOIN workdata w ON p.prod_plan_date = w.PROD_PLAN_DATE LEFT OUTER JOIN defectdate d ON p.prod_plan_date = d.prod_plan_date GROUP BY to_char(p.prod_plan_date, 'YYYY-IW') ORDER BY 계획일자
SELECT to_char(p.prod_plan_date,'YYYY-MM-DD') 계획일자, total_plan_qty 생산계획량, nvl(w.total_order_qty,0) 작업량, nvl(d.total_defect_qty,0) 불량수량, ( SELECT LISTAGG(dr.defect_name || ':' || dr.reason_qty, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY dr.reason_qty DESC) FROM defect_reason dr WHERE TO_CHAR(dr.prod_plan_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') = TO_CHAR(p.prod_plan_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') ) AS 불량사유상세 FROM plandata p LEFT OUTER JOIN workdata w ON p.prod_plan_date = w.PROD_PLAN_DATE LEFT OUTER JOIN defectdate d ON p.prod_plan_date = d.prod_plan_date ORDER BY p.prod_plan_date
SELECT to_char(p.prod_plan_date,'YYYY') 계획일자, sum(total_plan_qty) 생산계획량, sum(nvl(w.total_order_qty,0)) 작업량, sum(nvl(d.total_defect_qty,0)) 불량수량, ( SELECT LISTAGG(dr.defect_name || ':' || dr.reason_qty, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY dr.reason_qty DESC) FROM defect_reason dr WHERE TO_CHAR(dr.prod_plan_date, 'YYYY') = TO_CHAR(p.prod_plan_date, 'YYYY') ) AS 불량사유상세 FROM plandata p LEFT OUTER JOIN workdata w ON p.prod_plan_date = w.PROD_PLAN_DATE LEFT OUTER JOIN defectdate d ON p.prod_plan_date = d.prod_plan_date GROUP BY to_char(p.prod_plan_date, 'YYYY') ORDER BY 계획일자
SELECT to_char(p.prod_plan_date,'YYYY') 계획일자, round(avg(total_plan_qty),1) 생산계획량, round(avg(nvl(w.total_order_qty,0)),1) 작업량, round(avg(nvl(d.total_defect_qty,0)),1) 불량수량, ( SELECT LISTAGG(dr.defect_name || ':' || dr.reason_qty, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY dr.reason_qty DESC) FROM defect_reason dr WHERE TO_CHAR(dr.prod_plan_date, 'YYYY') = TO_CHAR(p.prod_plan_date, 'YYYY') ) AS 불량사유상세 FROM plandata p LEFT OUTER JOIN workdata w ON p.prod_plan_date = w.PROD_PLAN_DATE LEFT OUTER JOIN defectdate d ON p.prod_plan_date = d.prod_plan_date GROUP BY to_char(p.prod_plan_date, 'YYYY') ORDER BY 계획일자
SELECT to_char(p.prod_plan_date,'YYYY-MM') 계획일자, round(avg(total_plan_qty),1) 생산계획량, round(avg(nvl(w.total_order_qty,0)),1) 작업량, round(avg(nvl(d.total_defect_qty,0)),1) 불량수량, ( SELECT LISTAGG(dr.defect_name || ':' || dr.reason_qty, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY dr.reason_qty DESC) FROM defect_reason dr WHERE TO_CHAR(dr.prod_plan_date, 'YYYY-MM') = TO_CHAR(p.prod_plan_date, 'YYYY-MM') ) AS 불량사유상세 FROM plandata p LEFT OUTER JOIN workdata w ON p.prod_plan_date = w.PROD_PLAN_DATE LEFT OUTER JOIN defectdate d ON p.prod_plan_date = d.prod_plan_date GROUP BY to_char(p.prod_plan_date, 'YYYY-MM') ORDER BY 계획일자
